crime_highlights: Mr. Knight was arrested at approximately 10:00 a.m. for possession of a controlled substance
a backpack associated with Mr. Knight containing 21 individually packaged bags of methamphetamine
74 grams of caffeine, a substance commonly used as a cutting agent
rationale_highlights: the broader systemic and intergenerational factors associated with his challenging upbringing
properly inform the assessment of Mr. Knight's moral blameworthiness
I also treat the offender's Indigenous background and related lived experiences as a mitigating consideration, within the limits of the evidentiary record
operate as mitigation within the individualized proportionality analysis
note: No Gladue report; general-level consideration only.

crime_highlights: Mr. Downey stabbed Ms. Blimkie fifteen times with a folding knife
found her clutching her bleeding abdomen and expecting to die
She quickly lost consciousness, and, despite prompt medical intervention, did not survive.
he hid the knife he had used to kill Ms. Blimkie
rationale_highlights: broader systemic, structural, and community factors relating to Mr. Downey's experience as a Black person have played a part in his life experience
the aggravating effect of his criminal record is offset in part by the mitigating circumstances of his background, as detailed in the IRCA
note: Effect is partial offset of aggravation in parole ineligibility.

crime_highlights: Mr. A assaulted Ms. B in her own home
as she was passed out on her couch, either completely unconscious or in an alcohol-induced stupor
on at least two separate occasions Mr. A assaulted her
rationale_highlights: in sentencing Mr. A I must take into account his circumstances as an Indigenous offender
Mr. A's tragic life story is a terribly sad example of the destructive impacts of colonization and the assimilationist policies of settler government and agencies
have deprived him of meaningful social and community engagement and are greatly responsible for bringing him before the Court today
His moral blameworthiness is significantly reduced.
note: Victim impact is in paras 17 and 35, not adjacent to narrative.
